# Microeconomics (MSc)

> Lecture notes and exercises for an MSc microeconomics module at the University of Exeter: preferences, uncertainty, monopoly pricing and game theory.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/
